entry.name: plugin~
entry.digest: Define a Max for Live device's audio inputs
entry.description: The plugin~ object receives its input from the Live application as part of a Max for Live audio device.

arguments.name: input-channels
arguments.digest: Set the logical input channels for the Max For Live device.
arguments.description: Up to 64 input channels can be used, and the number refers to the logical input position. If there are no channels specified, a default of 2 channels will be used.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Receive audio from Max for Live
messages.description: By convention, a Max for Live gets all its audio from the Live application using theobject and sends its audio output using theobject. This audio output determined by the channel arguments to the object. This behavior is modified when Max for Live is in.

inlets.digest: (signal) Test input to pass thru for audio device channel 1.
(signal) Test input to pass thru for audio device channel 2.

outlets.digest: (signal) Channel 1 audio input from the Live application.
(signal) Channel 2 audio input from the Live application.
